FFmpeg 7.1.5 — "export-ass" LGPL static build for macOS arm64 + x86_64
STATUS: PENDING. No binary has been built and no binary digest is recorded.

Purpose: GenRight-class export pipelines — subtitle burn-in (libass `subtitles`/`ass`
filters), PNG decode (zlib) and h264_videotoolbox encode —
while keeping the catalog's LGPL-only, no-autodetect posture.

Recipe: crates/rightkit-media/recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh (pinned sources in
        recipes/ffmpeg-sources.json; the build refuses unpinned or mismatched sources).
FFmpeg configure (both arches):
  --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static --disable-shared
  --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small
  --enable-libass --enable-zlib --enable-videotoolbox --enable-audiotoolbox
  --pkg-config-flags=--static  (+ --arch/--cc as the decode build; x86_64 also
  --enable-cross-compile --target-os=darwin)
pkg-config is confined to the private dependency prefix (PKG_CONFIG_LIBDIR), so no
Homebrew/host library can be linked; the recipe fails unless otool -L lists only
/usr/lib and /System/Library imports. zlib, iconv, CoreText, VideoToolbox and
AudioToolbox are Apple system components.

Statically linked components (licence -> notice file shipped with the binary):
  FreeType 2.13.3     FTL (FTL option of FTL OR GPL-2.0-or-later)
                                          third-party/FreeType-FTL.txt (from docs/FTL.TXT)
  FriBidi 1.0.16      LGPL-2.1-or-later   third-party/FriBidi-COPYING.txt
  HarfBuzz 10.1.0     MIT-Modern-Variant  third-party/HarfBuzz-COPYING.txt
                      (confirm identifier against COPYING when fetched)
  libass 0.17.3       ISC                 third-party/libass-COPYING.txt
Binary SPDX: LGPL-2.1-or-later AND FTL AND MIT-Modern-Variant AND ISC
LGPL obligations: FFmpeg and FriBidi are statically linked into one executable;
ship the notices plus a written source offer covering their complete sources and this
recipe so a recipient can rebuild/relink. FreeType's FTL requires the credit line in
product documentation.

To produce and promote (run on the macOS build host from tools/rightkit/crates/rightkit-media):
  1. recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh fetch --variant export-ass --sources <src-dir>
     Compare the printed digests with each upstream release, then pin freetype, fribidi,
     harfbuzz and libass sha256 in recipes/ffmpeg-sources.json (ffmpeg is pinned).
  2. Ensure meson and ninja are on PATH (harfbuzz uses meson; this host has no meson).
  3. recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh build --variant export-ass --arch arm64 --tool ffmpeg \
       --sources <src-dir> --work <work-dir> --out <out-dir>
     recipes/build-ffmpeg-macos.sh build --variant export-ass --arch x86_64 --tool ffmpeg \
       --sources <src-dir> --work <work-dir> --out <out-dir>
  4. Copy <out-dir>/ffmpeg-export-ass-macos-<arch> to vendor/ffmpeg-lgpl/, copy the
     upstream notices from <out-dir>/ffmpeg-export-ass-macos-<arch>.notices/ to the
     third-party/ names above, then in catalog/artifacts.json record each binary sha256
     (from <out-dir>/*.evidence.json) and every component sourceSha256, set status
     "approved" and delete "pending". The crate tests then require the notices to exist.
